reason: Within a tool loop Nebula replayed earlier calls as a flat list of ModelToolResult (id, name, arguments, output): every call became its own assistant message with no reasoning, so routes that need their reasoning state back lost it or reject the next step (DeepSeek/V4 reasoning_content, OpenRouter reasoning_details including DeepSeek V4's empty list, Gemini 3 thoughtSignature, Anthropic thinking blocks, Responses encrypted reasoning), and a parallel batch was split into single-call exchanges. The newest browser screenshot was also sent as an extra user message ahead of every call. Adapters now capture bounded replay state (ModelResponse.reasoning_state stamped with the provider and model that made it, ToolCall.provider_metadata for Gemini signatures and OpenAI-compatible extra_content); chat stores it once on the first tool_history entry of each routing response plus a response_group key on every entry (refused calls, including #500's unreadable calls, share their batch, Core-made delivery steps get their own core-<step> group, restart reconciliation keeps the fields); _provider_tool_history passes them through new ModelToolResult fields. Each adapter replays one assistant message per batch followed by its results, with the reasoning its flavor expects: OpenRouter echoes reasoning_details as received (signature-less signed text dropped, reasoning text only beside non-empty details, [] back-filled for DeepSeek V4), DeepSeek sends reasoning_content (V4 back-fills '' on every assistant message, legacy deepseek-reasoner gets none for earlier turns), Z.ai-style preserved thinking only with clear_thinking false, Gemini replays signatures or the documented skip_thought_signature_validator sentinel on Gemini 3, Anthropic replays thinking blocks unchanged before tool_use, Responses requests and replays encrypted reasoning items for reasoning models. State from another provider or model is never replayed. History without groups still replays one call per message. The screenshot now travels inside the tool result (Anthropic, Bedrock, Responses, Gemini) or as a user message right after the batch's tool messages (Chat Completions). tests/v3/test_reasoning_replay.py (22 tests, all failing on origin/main) drives real adapters through the chat tool loop over a 2-step loop in a follow-up turn; the selected existing tests are the edited screenshot test and the closest tests of the routing batch, refused and delivery steps, stream call merging and each adapter's replayed-history wire contract, plus the #499/#500/#501 tests of the code the rebase merged with (tool-call assembly and _tool_call, unreadable-call refusals, json_object payload instructions, routing after a tool step).
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through chat.py/providers.py/context.py) uses a scripted provider and does not exercise vendor reasoning state or batch replay; the Python tests drive the adapters directly. test_providers.py, test_provider_contracts.py, test_chat_tool_loop.py, test_chat_routing_tolerance.py, test_browser_companion.py, test_context.py, test_dsml.py, test_provider_verification.py, test_chat.py, test_chat_subagents.py, test_chat_goals.py, test_harness_provider_subagents.py, test_chat_media.py, test_chat_reconnection.py, test_chat_final_synthesis_recovery.py, test_model_output_budget.py, test_native_adapter_outcomes.py, test_inference_timeouts_probe_budget.py, test_tool_call_assembly.py, test_malformed_tool_call_feedback.py, test_deepseek_glm_compat.py and test_routing_prose_answer.py were run locally in full and pass but are not selected. No full suites.
